Christine Marie helped take down a cult leader — a self-proclaimed prophet of a Fundamentalist Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints community in Utah.

In an exclusive interview, Marie and director Rachel Dretzin share about their new docuseries, “Trust Me: The False Prophet,” and working with the mother of five of the leader’s wives to gather evidence leading to his arrest. | CBS Mornings | Facebook
